title: PVP_weapon
description: This plugin enables your Minecraft high-version PVP to have the same experience as that of the low-version PVP
body:
This plugin lets you get low-version-style attack weapons and various mini-game items in newer Minecraft versions.


Enter the command **/pvp give attackspeed [play name] [item id] [attack damage]** to get a weapon with no attack cooldown

Enter the command**/pvp give fireball/fire charge [play name]** to get a throwable fire charge

Enter the command**/pvp give hook/fishing_rod [play name]** to get a Fishing Rod with Knockback Hook

Enter the command**/pvp give killaxe [play name]** to get a One-Hit KO Axe

This are all commands used by this plugin, Have fun gaming!
